metadata.rivers: traced by priority-flood routing on the DEM; at least 1500 km² upstream anywhere in mainland Ecuador, at least 60 km² inside each catchment's map window; simplified to 0.002°
metadata.relief: mainland Ecuador at or above 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000 m, on 3 × 3 blocks of the overview, simplified to 0.005°, patches under 15 km² dropped
